title: Diene flutter-base primordial chart values
description: The LogtoApp identity CR for the diene flutter-base mobile client plus its Grafana Operator rendering. Validated against the base values and every stacked landscape/cluster overlay. There is no platformDependencies surface and no Problem surface: a store-distributed Flutter binary owns no database, kv, cache, or object store, and it consumes backend problem types rather than publishing a catalog.

logtoApp.description: The single LogtoApp CR for this app. The mobile client is the placement owner for its own identity. `Native` is the only application type a store-distributed public client can hold: it runs authorization-code + PKCE with no confidential secret.

type.description: Constrained to Native. A store-installed binary cannot hold a confidential secret, so Traditional and MachineToMachine are unrepresentable here rather than merely discouraged.

paths.description: Declared paths only, and empty for this node: a native client has no HTTP origin for the operator to derive `origin(L) + declaredPath` from. The slots stay declarable so a later universal-link path is validated the same way an HTTP sibling's is.

extraRedirectUris.description: The custom-scheme OAuth callbacks this native client redeems, one per store track. Load-bearing here, not exceptional: each must be an absolute URI carrying a scheme, because a bare path is accepted by Logto and fails only at redirect in the installed binary.

extraCorsOrigins.description: None for a native client: it issues no browser cross-origin request.

datasourceUids.description: Platform-pinned datasource UIDs. `frontend` is present because this node ships a live Faro client rail, so a mobile RUM signal has a datasource to be alerted on.

absoluteUri.description: An absolute URI with a scheme (RFC 3986 §3.1). Permits the custom app scheme a native OAuth callback uses, which is not an https URL.
